summary: At a populated model world, well-founded causal predecessors yield an actual existent with no incoming cause from another actual existent; existence-PSR adds a stipulated reason for its existence fact. Removing causal well-foundedness permits a mutually-causing pair satisfying PSR and universal external causation; removing population makes universal predicates vacuous. Explicitly non-divine and non-modal conclusion; adequacy of explanatory reasons unestablished. See docs/causal-finite-branching-and-psr-syllogisms.md. A later operational configuration adapter now exposes the already existing all_external_causes_impossible theorem as a three-listed-premise ConfigurationFalse result: selected-world population, selected-world full causal WF, and all-world EveryExistentExternallyCaused. No explanation/PSR premise is used. CONFIG-LOCAL-EXISTENCE-PSR registers it and the three-atom selection; unchanged registered EmptyWorld (drop population), MutualCauses (drop WF), and Intrinsic (drop external causation) supply the single-removal interpretations. This is reuse and propagation, not a new philosophical discovery, new model, or root-premise closure. Existing model certificates are trusted rather than rerun. The frozen CausalHarvest Challenge and single persistent-session Solution diagnostics cover this adapter; final delivered CI, not local repeated Comparator/model gates, is authoritative.
